title: RML-G1 capacity-aligned control and stable-context repair
summary: Supersede the unratified G1A v1 amendment before any model call: certify NONE and P-ATOMS over the complete shared visible-history policy class; align the prospective empirical P-ATOMS construct gate with its exact 1/2 capacity; and replace an unavailable volatile Stage-A report binding with a freshly reviewed exact report plus a mechanically defined stable semantic projection. Preserve every other approved G1 boundary.
system_thesis: A supplied-memory construct gate must separate what a control can legitimately do from what the pinned model happens to do. A control outcome at its exact information capacity is not leakage and must not falsely terminate the paper path; governance evidence must also be replayable from available exact bytes.

nodes.before: The original contract asserts P-ATOMS structural capacity 0/2; the unratified G1A v1 computes a repair but leaves the production certifier unspecified.
nodes.after: A production offline evaluator certifies K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2 over one complete deterministic shared authorized-visible-history policy, with replayable lower-bound policy and independently checked upper-bound certificate; capacity artifacts are evaluator-only.
nodes.rationale: Open-loop signature intersection is insufficient even though it happens to return the correct values on this slice.

nodes.before: Both registered P-ATOMS trajectories must be scientifically valid nonsuccesses, so observed 1/2 terminates G1 even though the control can legitimately solve one side.
nodes.after: Both registered P-ATOMS trajectories must be scientifically valid; observed 0/2 is strict-control-clean, 1/2 is capacity-attaining and may proceed without earning positive-method credit, and 2/2 stops as inconsistent with certified capacity.
nodes.rationale: The old 0/2 threshold was downstream of the disproved zero-capacity premise and would produce a false stop.

nodes.before: Original deliberation references unavailable generated Stage-A bytes whose identity includes volatile wall-time and RSS fields.
nodes.after: Fresh deliberation binds the current exact D0 code and report and a mechanically recomputable stable semantic projection excluding only the two declared volatile resource paths; volatile receipts remain reported separately.
nodes.rationale: Exact review cannot claim to replay missing bytes, while runtime receipts should not define semantic instrument identity.

edges.before: A false zero structural ceiling motivates an exact observed 0/2 pass requirement.
edges.after: The independently checked 1/2 structural capacity defines the allowed empirical control range; only above-capacity 2/2 blocks for construct/runtime investigation.
edges.rationale: Structural possibility and observed model behavior become typed, capacity-coherent quantities.

loops.before: The first amendment would preserve a false-stop empirical gate and exact review depends on a missing volatile context artifact.
loops.after: Re-ground D0 semantics from current exact available bytes and stable projection; seal source-only stores and target manifest; certify complete-policy capacities without selection feedback; require the six original plus strengthened repair tests and two bound reviewers; run a target-disjoint canary; then dispatch the unchanged 18 trajectories and at most 234 scientific calls once without retry. P-ATOMS 0/2 or 1/2 may proceed, while 2/2 or any invalid control outcome stops.
loops.trigger: Exact human ratification of the final adjudicated bytes, complete CPU evidence, two fresh bound approvals, and a passing target-disjoint runtime canary.

loops.stop_condition: Stop before scientific dispatch on any leak, provenance, capacity, source, selection, stable-projection, test, review, runtime, resource, or canary failure; after dispatch stop without retry on infrastructure/resource failure or P-ATOMS 2/2.
loops.rationale: This is the smallest prospective repair that makes both the scientific control and its audit trail valid.

claims.before: Observed P-ATOMS 0/2 is required and may inherit a structural-zero interpretation.
claims.after: Observed P-ATOMS is reported as an exact typed count against certified capacity 1/2: 0/2 strict-control-clean; 1/2 capacity-attaining qualified control; 2/2 construct/runtime contradiction. Neither 0/2 nor 1/2 is paper evidence or a statistical estimate.
claims.evidence_needed: Pre-GPU exact capacity certificate and checker, two scientifically valid P-ATOMS traces, immutable raw outputs, and post-run bound review.

claims.before: Review implicitly treats unavailable SHA-256 346bd091... Stage-A report bytes as replayable.
claims.after: The missing artifact is disclosed; current exact D0 bytes and stable semantic projection are freshly reviewed and ratified. No equivalence to the missing raw receipt is claimed.
claims.evidence_needed: Projection recomputation, current D0 test pass, exact context hashes, and independent review.

acceptance_tests.setup: After source/store and selected-manifest seal, enumerate every single-side successful four-READ/nine-ENV trace and exact authorized visible history; solve cross-side policy compatibility; replay one lower-bound policy; independently check the upper-bound certificate; run false-split, authorized-split, side-swap, hidden-bit, feedback, extra-action, scratch/citation, witness, and certificate mutations.
acceptance_tests.expected: K_NONE is exactly 1/4 and K_P_ATOMS exactly 1/2 under one complete shared deterministic visible-history policy; open-loop-only, hidden-dependent, incomplete, or corrupt certificates fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The selected controls have the claimed exact capacities or the certificate covers the allowed policy class.

acceptance_tests.setup: Feed the reducer typed P-ATOMS outcome vectors 0/2, 1/2, 2/2 and invalid/infra/resource/cancelled variants while holding the certified capacity and roster fixed.
acceptance_tests.expected: 0/2 and 1/2 pass only the construct-control range with distinct labels; 2/2 and every non-scientifically-valid denominator fail; positive-method credit never comes from ATOMS.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The empirical control is aligned to structural capacity without laundering control success into evidence.

acceptance_tests.setup: Disclose the unavailable original report hash; recompute the stable semantic projection from the current exact report by deleting only /gate_values/resource_record and /resource_hash; bind current D0 code hashes; rerun all 16 D0 tests; mutate one semantic field and each exclusion rule.
acceptance_tests.expected: Projection SHA-256 and length match the declared values; only volatile receipt changes leave it invariant; semantic/code/exclusion mutations fail; no equivalence to missing bytes is claimed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The currently reviewable D0 semantics support G1 or the governance recovery is reproducible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Rebuild base stores hermetically from sealed public source/schema leaves; verify row/index/alias/order/query/handle/render lineage; mutate hidden target fields, ambient files/env/globals/cache, capacity artifacts, selected side, condition, and same-key serving prefixes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every content byte has source-only lineage; authorized target-interface variation is partitioned from invariant store/build/serve bytes; hidden and evaluator-only information cannot alter cognition or side channels.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The supplied-gold control is target-independent and nonleaking.

acceptance_tests.setup: Diff the final packet against original G1 consensus/ratification and this amendment; verify exact roster/order/opportunity identities, prompt/model/runtime/resources, selection before capacity, interventions, typed outcomes, reviews, canary, no-retry ledger, post-run review, and claim whitelist; reject every non-allowlisted delta.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only complete-policy certification, capacity-aligned P-ATOMS interpretation, source/leak enforcement, and stable-context governance recovery differ; all original causal and resource gates remain prerequisites.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The repair is prospective, minimal, and cannot covertly widen G1.

human_boundary.decision_question: Ratify the final prospective G1 repair: certify exact complete-policy capacities NONE 1/4 and P-ATOMS 1/2; allow scientifically valid observed P-ATOMS 0/2 or 1/2 to pass the construct control while blocking 2/2; freshly bind the current D0 bytes and declared stable semantic projection instead of pretending the unavailable volatile report is replayable; and preserve every other original G1 roster, source/leak, runtime/resource, intervention, review, no-retry, and claim boundary?
forbidden_before_approval: implementation of the capacity-aligned threshold or production capacity certifier
binding pre-GPU review, model canary, or scientific GPU dispatch
silent substitution or equivalence claim for missing Stage-A report bytes
changing targets, candidate order, prompts, model, roster, resources, interventions, or claims beyond the exact adjudicated repair
